findings.claim: The new Markdown routes emit MDX component syntax verbatim, so seven of eight documentation pages are not ordinary agent-readable Markdown.
findings.evidence: /docs/commands.md contains Properties and Property tags, while /docs/index.md contains Cards, Steps, Step, and Callout tags. Important content is carried in component attributes instead of Markdown headings, lists, or prose.

findings.claim: Sitemap and Markdown freshness metadata report deployment materialization time rather than content modification time.
findings.evidence: The production build reports every sitemap page at 2026-08-14T21:12:20Z and every Markdown page as last_updated 2026-08-14, while Git history ranges from 2026-03-26 through 2026-08-08.

findings.claim: HTML 404 pages inherit the homepage canonical URL and Markdown alternate.
findings.evidence: Both /does-not-exist and /docs/does-not-exist return HTTP 404 with noindex but emit canonical https://ai-cli.dev and alternate text/markdown https://ai-cli.dev/index.md.
findings.path: apps/web/app/layout.tsx metadata -> Next.js root layout inheritance -> HTML 404 response
